name: feature-progress
description: A tool any spec-driven flow calls to report the progress of a feature and its tasks; a band above the prompt shows the stage and the count, and a pane lists every task with its state, round, steps and note.

folder.title: Folder of the feature files
folder.description: Where the mod keeps one JSON file per feature, relative to the session's working directory or absolute. Empty uses .claude/feature-progress/.

staleMinutes.title: Minutes before a feature is stale
staleMinutes.description: Minutes without a report before the band and the pane mark an open feature as stale. A waiting or done feature is never stale. 0 turns the marker off.

editor.title: Program that opens a task link
editor.description: auto: VS Code when its code command is available, else the system's default program. vscode: always VS Code. system: always the system's default program.

showBand.title: Show the band
showBand.description: Shows the open feature in a band above the prompt. Off hides the band; the pane, the reports and /feature-progress still work. /feature-progress band turns it on or off.

paneBackground.title: Pane background in the terminal
paneBackground.description: A color for the body of the pane in the terminal, as hex (#2e3440) or a color name, for example your terminal's background. It also drops the theme color of the frame around the pane, so the frame shows the terminal's own background. Leave empty to keep the colors Claude Code draws. The desktop app ignores it.

icons.title: Icon set
icons.description: The glyphs of the states in the band and the pane. unicode works everywhere; nerd needs a Nerd Font; emoji needs a terminal that draws emoji two cells wide.
